theorems.name: Submission.p02_es_177ebb5a_scl_linepow_coeff_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (z : ℂ) (d : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ), ‖MvPolynomial.coeff d (HeckeEis.linePow n z).val‖ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ n * (max 1 ‖z‖) ^ n
theorems.natural_summary: The coefficient vanishes unless d 0 + d 1 = n; otherwise it equals choose(n, d 0) · z^(d 0). Bound the binomial coefficient by 2^n and use d 0 ≤ n and max(1, ‖z‖) ≥ 1 to bound the remaining factor.
